Top Golf Menu: The Ultimate Guide to Food and Drinks

Topgolf isn’t just known for its fun and interactive golfing experience; it’s also famous for offering an incredible selection of food and drinks. Whether you’re working up an appetite while hitting balls or visiting just for the dining experience, the Topgolf menu is packed with a wide range of delicious options that cater to all tastes. From shareables to salads, burgers to flatbreads, and a variety of beverages, this guide will cover everything you need to know about Topgolf’s food and drink menu. Get ready for a mouthwatering journey through the menu, including detailed pricing tables, FAQ sections, and even restaurant timings.

Topgolf Menu Overview

Topgolf is known for its diverse menu that includes an array of tasty dishes and beverages to suit everyone’s preferences. With everything from appetizers to desserts, the Topgolf food and drink menu has you covered whether you’re craving something light or indulgent.

Shareables: Perfect for the Group

If you’re looking for something to share while you play, Topgolf’s shareables are a must. They offer a variety of appetizers that are perfect for groups.

Popular Shareables:

  • Topgolf Nachos: Loaded nachos topped with cheese, jalapeños, and guacamole.
  • Buffalo Chicken Dip: A creamy blend of buffalo sauce, cheese, and tender shredded chicken, served with tortilla chips.

Shareables Pricing Table

Shareable Dishes Price
Topgolf Nachos $9.99
Buffalo Chicken Dip $8.49

Burgers and Sandwiches

For a more substantial meal, the burgers and sandwiches at Topgolf are filling and flavorful. They are made with high-quality ingredients like grilled chicken, steak, and fried chicken, and served with crispy fries on the side.

Popular Burgers & Sandwiches:

  • Classic Burger: A juicy burger topped with cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, and onion.
  • Grilled Chicken Sandwich: Tender, marinated grilled chicken breast served on a toasted bun with a side of fries.
  • Buffalo Fried Chicken Sandwich: Crispy fried chicken tossed in buffalo sauce, topped with ranch dressing.

Burgers and Sandwiches Pricing Table

Burgers & Sandwiches Price
Classic Burger $11.99
Grilled Chicken Sandwich $10.49
Buffalo Fried Chicken Sandwich $12.49

Salads and Lighter Options

If you’re looking for a healthier meal, Topgolf offers a range of salads and lighter options that are perfect for those who want to enjoy something fresh and nutritious.

Popular Salads:

  • House Salad: A fresh mix of greens, onions, cheddar, tomatoes, and croutons, served with your choice of dressing.
  • Cobb Salad: A hearty salad with grilled chicken, bacon, hard-boiled egg, cheese, and avocado.

Salads Pricing Table

Salad Options Price
House Salad $8.49
Cobb Salad $11.99

Flatbreads: A Tasty Option for Everyone

Topgolf’s flatbreads are a favorite for those who want a lighter yet filling meal. Whether you’re a meat lover or prefer vegetarian options, the flatbreads deliver on flavor.

Popular Flatbreads:

  • Buffalo Chicken Flatbread: Topped with buffalo chicken, blue cheese, and ranch.
  • Margherita Flatbread: A simple yet flavorful combination of tomato, mozzarella, and fresh basil.
  • Korean BBQ Flatbread: Topped with shredded pork, korean BBQ sauce, and fresh cilantro.

Flatbreads Pricing Table

Flatbread Options Price

Margherita Flatbread $8.49
Korean BBQ Flatbread $10.49

Sides and Add-Ons

Complete your meal with some delicious sides or customize it with add-ons. The sides menu includes options like fries, chips, and onion rings that pair perfectly with any main course.

Popular Sides:

  • French Fries: Golden and crispy fries seasoned to perfection.
  • Onion Rings: Thick-cut onion rings, fried until crispy and served with ranch.

Sides Pricing Table

Side Options Price
French Fries $3.49
Onion Rings $4.49

Topgolf Drink Menu: A Variety of Beverages

Topgolf’s drink menu has a wide selection of beverages, from beer to specialty cocktails, and non-alcoholic drinks. Whether you’re in the mood for a craft beer or a refreshing soda, Topgolf has something for everyone.

Popular Drinks:

  • Craft Beer: A variety of local and craft beers are available on tap.
  • Margarita: A classic cocktail with tequila, lime, and a salted rim.
  • Topgolf Signature Sangria: A refreshing blend of red wine, fruit juices, and a splash of brandy.

Drink Menu Pricing Table

Drink Options Price
Craft Beer (16oz) $7.99
Margarita $9.49

Desserts: Sweet Endings to Your Meal

No meal is complete without a little something sweet, and Topgolf’s dessert menu does not disappoint. From injectable donut holes to ice cream sundaes, the dessert options are indulgent and delicious.

Popular Desserts:

  • Injectable Donut Holes: Warm donut holes served with three injectable fillings: chocolate, raspberry, and Bavarian cream.
  • Cookie Skillet: A giant chocolate chip cookie, baked in a skillet and served with vanilla ice cream.

Desserts Pricing Table

Dessert Options Price
Injectable Donut Holes $7.49

Health-Conscious and Dietary Options

Topgolf offers several vegetarian and gluten-free options to accommodate different dietary preferences. For those who prefer lighter fare or have dietary restrictions, these menu items are just as flavorful as the traditional options.

Vegetarian & Gluten-Free Items:

  • Hummus Plate: A creamy hummus served with fresh vegetables and pita chips.
  • Gluten-Free Chicken Wings: Crispy chicken wings tossed in your choice of sauce, served with celery and blue cheese.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Does Topgolf offer vegetarian options?

Yes, Topgolf offers a variety of vegetarian options such as the Margherita Flatbread, Hummus Plate, and House Salad.

2. Can I customize my order?

Absolutely! You can customize your burgers, sandwiches, and even some of the appetizers. Just let the staff know your preferences when placing your order.

3. Does Topgolf have a dessert menu?

Yes, Topgolf has a dessert menu with popular items like Injectable Donut Holes and the Cookie Skillet.

4. What drinks are available at Topgolf?

Topgolf offers a wide selection of beverages, including craft beers, cocktails, and non-alcoholic options like sodas and juices.

5. Are there gluten-free options on the Topgolf menu?

Yes, Topgolf provides several gluten-free options, including gluten-free chicken wings and salads.

Restaurant Timings

The operating hours for Topgolf locations can vary, but most venues follow these general timings:

  • Monday to Thursday: 10 AM – 11 PM
  • Friday and Saturday: 10 AM – 1 AM
  • Sunday: 10 AM – 10 PM

It’s always a good idea to check with your local Topgolf venue for exact timings or any special hours during holidays.
